# google_design_center_application

Application Design Center Application.

## Example Usage - Designcenter Application Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_application" "example" {
  project           = "my-project-name"
  location          = "us-central1"
  space             = "example-space"
  application_id    = "example-application"
  deployment_region = "us-central1"

  source {
    application_template_revision = "projects/my-project-name/locations/us-central1/spaces/example-space/applicationTemplates/example-template/revisions/r-1"
  }

  scope {
    type = "REGIONAL"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `source` -
  (Required)
  DeploymentSource for the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_source).

* `scope` -
  (Required)
  AppHub Scope for the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_scope).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the space.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The space for the application.

* `application_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the application.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display name.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the application.

* `app_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  A list of parameters to attach to the deployment source object, which is
  a catalog entry or an application template snapshot. When unset, the API
  fills these in from the application template.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_app_parameters).

* `component_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  A list of component parameters to associate with the application. When
  unset, the API fills these in from the application template.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_component_parameters).

* `service_account` -
  (Optional)
  Service account for deployment.

* `attributes` -
  (Optional)
  Attributes of the App Hub application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_attributes).

* `deployment_region` -
  (Optional)
  Deployment region.

* `deployment_project` -
  (Optional)
  Deployment project.

* `connection_configs` -
  (Optional)
  Connection configurations for the application. When the application is
  created or its source changes, the API sets these from the connections
  in the application template.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_connection_configs).

* `deployment_target` -
  (Optional)
  The deployment target of the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_deployment_target).

* `composite_application_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters that are required for composite applications.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_composite_application_parameters).

* `roles_apis_config` -
  (Optional)
  Project-specific configurations required to deploy the application,
  including IAM roles and APIs. When unset, the API fills in the roles and
  APIs that the deployment needs.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_roles_apis_config).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

<a name="nested_deployment_target_gke_deployment_target"></a>The `gke_deployment_target` block supports:

<a name="nested_roles_apis_config_apis"></a>The `apis` block supports:

  (Required)

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applications/{{application_id}}`

* `name` -
  Name of the application.

* `state` -
  State of the application.

* `deployment_metadata` -
  Deployment metadata of the application.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_deployment_metadata).

* `apphub_application` -
  AppHub application URI.

* `create_time` -
  Create time.

* `update_time` -
  Update time.


<a name="nested_deployment_metadata"></a>The `deployment_metadata` block contains:

* `revision` -
  (Output)
  The revision of the deployment associated with the application.

* `component_output_parameters` -
  (Output)
  The component output parameters of the deployment.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_deployment_metadata_component_output_parameters).

* `error` -
  (Output)
  The error associated with the deployment.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_deployment_metadata_error).

* `build` -
  (Output)
  The Cloud Build instance UUID associated with the deployment.

* `worker_pool` -
  (Output)
  The Cloud Build worker pool used to deploy the application.

* `retry_attempts` -
  (Output)
  The number of deployment retries attempted.


<a name="nested_deployment_metadata_component_output_parameters"></a>The `component_output_parameters` block contains:

* `component` -
  (Output)
  The name of the component that the output parameters belong to.

* `parameters` -
  (Output)
  The output parameters of the component.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_deployment_metadata_component_output_parameters_parameters).


<a name="nested_deployment_metadata_component_output_parameters_parameters"></a>The `parameters` block contains:

* `key` -
  (Output)
  The key of the parameter.

* `value` -
  (Output)
  The value of the parameter, as a JSON-encoded string.

<a name="nested_deployment_metadata_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `type` -
  (Output)
  The error type based on the deployment error code.

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The deployment error code, based on the Infrastructure Manager
  error codes.

* `detail` -
  (Output)
  A human-readable summary of the deployment error.

* `error_message` -
  (Output)
  The errors generated by Infrastructure Manager, and any
  non-internal errors that occurred before the deployment started.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Application can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applications/{{application_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Application using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    application_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_application.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Application using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applications/{{application_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_application.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Application can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_application.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applications/{{application_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_id}}
```

This resource supports [User Project Overrides](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/provider_reference#user_project_override).
